# India Today

> > India Today is India's leading news organization providing breaking news, live TV streaming, and in-depth coverage of politics, elections, business, and international affairs across multiple languages and platforms.

India Today operates a comprehensive digital news ecosystem covering national politics, state elections, stock market updates, and geopolitical developments. The platform serves diverse audiences through regional portals (Malayalam), live TV streaming, magazine archives, and specialized sections on business, jobs, and education.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Election Coverage
- India Politics
- Assembly Elections
- Tamil Nadu
- Kerala
- West Bengal
- Stock Market
- BJP
- Congress
- Middle East Crisis
- Iran-Israel Conflict
- Personal Finance
- IPO News
- International Affairs

## News & Breaking Updates

- [Latest News, Breaking News Today](https://www.indiatoday.in): Homepage with breaking news on politics, business, cricket, entertainment and international affairs
- [India News - Breaking News Headlines](https://www.indiatoday.in/india): Breaking news and live updates on India politics, crime and government
- [India Today Live TV](https://www.indiatoday.in/livetv): 24/7 live TV streaming with breaking news, politics and geopolitical coverage
- [Video Programmes from India Today Television](https://www.indiatoday.in/programmes): Video news programs and TV shows from India Today Television

## Elections 2026

- [Election 2026 Coverage](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections): Election 2026 coverage for Tamil Nadu, Kerala, West Bengal and Assam
- [Election Schedule 2026](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections/assembly/schedule): Election schedule with voting dates and result timelines for 2026 assemblies
- [Tamil Nadu Assembly Election 2026](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections/assembly/tamil-nadu): Tamil Nadu election coverage with candidate lists and political party updates
- [Kerala Assembly Election 2026](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections/assembly/kerala): Kerala election news covering Congress, UDF and CPM-LDF alliances
- [West Bengal Assembly Election 2026](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections/assembly/west-bengal): West Bengal election coverage with TMC, BJP candidates and Mamata Banerjee updates

## Business & Markets

- [Business News Headlines](https://www.indiatoday.in/business): Business news covering stock market, economy, commodities and investments
- [Share Market News - Sensex, Nifty Updates](https://www.indiatoday.in/business/market): Real-time stock market updates on Sensex, Nifty and major indices
- [IPO News - Latest and Upcoming IPOs](https://www.indiatoday.in/business/ipo): IPO news, allotment details and listing updates for Indian stock market
- [Personal Finance News](https://www.indiatoday.in/business/personal-finance): Personal finance advice covering investments, savings, tax planning and insurance
- [Companies News](https://www.indiatoday.in/business/companies): Corporate news and updates on major Indian companies and banking sector

## Magazine & Analysis

- [India Today Magazine](https://www.indiatoday.in/magazine): Digital magazine archive with cover stories on cricket, geopolitics and current affairs
- [India Today Insight - In-Depth Analysis](https://www.indiatoday.in/india-today-magazine-insight): In-depth analysis and opinion pieces on politics, entertainment and policy

## Education & Careers

- [Best Colleges in India 2026 Ranking](https://bestcolleges.indiatoday.in): College rankings and education guide covering engineering, medical and other streams
- [Latest Jobs News & Career Advice](https://www.indiatoday.in/jobs): Job listings, career advice and government employment news for India

## Regional & Language Editions

- [India Today Malayalam News](https://malayalam.indiatoday.in): Regional Malayalam news portal covering Kerala politics, entertainment, sports and business
